canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Rocket Mortgage denied {value} of its 96,051 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Rocket Mortgage decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Rocket Mortgage will deny any specific future application with 29.8% probability
Rocket Mortgage is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Rocket Mortgage discriminates or violates law
29.8% applies to Rocket Mortgage's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
